a.title: Soon-to-be merged Paramount and Warner Bros. will be known as Skydance going forward

b.lede: Paramount Skydance CEO David Ellison has announced that the company will just be called Skydance when it completes its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery next week.
